name: Six Senses London
positioning: A wellness-focused hotel set within The Whiteley, a reimagined West London landmark near Notting Hill
best_for: City travelers who want a serious spa and fitness offering
Guests who want a West London base near Notting Hill and Hyde Park

facts.text: The hotel is at 1 Redan Place in West London.
The hotel offers courtyard calm, with Notting Hill just around the corner.
The neighborhood offers Notting Hill color and Hyde Park calm.
Rooms feature soothing tones and leafy touches.
Six Senses Residences London is located within The Whiteley.
The Fitness Center includes a light-filled studio and a team of professionals to guide training.
Past the reflective pool, the Wellness Studio offers space for mindful movement and restorative practices.
Six Senses London has the first Six Senses Place, open to members and hotel guests.
Whiteley's Kitchen serves British cooking with seasonal, locally sourced ingredients transformed with fire and fermentation.
Whiteley's Cafe offers homemade bakes with small-batch coffee.

highlights.text: The hotel is set within The Whiteley, a reimagined West London landmark.
The spa offers treatments from cryotherapy to flotation.
Across a bridge flanked by two natural tree sculptures, the Alchemy Bar turns British seasonal herbs into blends to create and take home.
It is home to the first Six Senses Place, a space for connection and well-being open to members and hotel guests.

considerations.text: The building also houses Six Senses Residences London and the members' Six Senses Place, so it is not a hotel-only address.
WhataHotel notes the wellness-focused concept may not appeal to all travelers.
